description: NaNb(CuS₂)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ama2 space group. Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 3.41-3.45 Å. Nb is bonded to four S atoms to form NbS₄ tetrahedra that share edges with four CuS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Nb-S bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.34 Å. There are two inequivalent Cu sites. In the first Cu site, Cu is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted CuS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent CuS₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NbS₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.34 Å) and two longer (2.35 Å) Cu-S bond lengths. In the second Cu site, Cu is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted CuS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six CuS₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NbS₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.32 Å) and two longer (2.35 Å) Cu-S bond lengths. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and three Cu atoms. In the second S site, S is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Nb and two Cu atoms. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Nb, and one Cu atom.
